limitations: random and size_matched filter on the cap at pick date: the PIT snapshot cap when one exists, otherwise the newest snapshot cap holding the symbol rescaled by close(pick)/close(snapshot), which assumes a constant share count
info_rescaled (symbols in no snapshot) uses today's marketCap from a live yfinance quote, so its share count is today's, not the pick date's

survivorship: a date with a universe snapshot samples that day's listing (pickMinus.randomPitUniverse); names delisted before the first snapshot (2026-10-09) are still absent; dates without a snapshot sample today's listing (pickMinus.randomCurrentUniverse)
per-arm tStat treats same-date rows as independent; read pickMinus (paired by date) instead
overlapping windows: consecutive H20 windows overlap, so even paired tStat is overstated
small n: tens of observations per arm; tStat near zero is not proof of equality
top2_5, random and size_matched arms were never published; only the measurement semantics match
